summary:
SQLAlchemy 2 cleanup and logging improvements are complete: structured logging now includes request IDs, payment failures use `logger.exception`, and invoice creation no longer prints. Payment tests, logging tests, and invoice API tests pass. The full suite previously passed 149 tests, with only Stripe sandbox tests skipped.

Configuration loading now logs only the setting count and source path via debug output, without exposing sensitive values. Added logging coverage for a null request ID and updated the health-log field expectations.

Investigated and fixed a scheduler DST bug: recurrence calculations now preserve the intended local wall time when converting timezone-aware datetimes to UTC. Scheduler tests pass, including a new spring-forward midnight transition test. Timezone handling was verified with `zoneinfo`.

Before further work, rebase uncommitted/squashable changes onto `origin/main`, keep commits small, use only staging Redis `cache-eu-3`, and never write to draining `cache-eu-1`. The next task remains fixing `ledgerly/money.py` so JPY amounts do not receive two decimal places.
per_round:
Completed and committed the invoice-sync idempotency race fix as `fix-billing-idempotency-race`. Added a concurrent duplicate-request regression test, stress-tested 200 requests (8 submissions, 192 replays, no 500s), verified one completed idempotency record, and improved test fixture cleanup. Validation passed: 126 repository tests passed with 3 skipped, 31 integration tests passed, and Ruff checks were clean.

Work then shifted to paginating `GET /v1/invoices`. Added `InvoicePage`, updated `InvoiceService.list_invoices` to accept `limit`/`offset`, and changed the API to return `{items, total, limit, offset}` with validated query parameters and a count query. Existing invoice API tests now have one expected failure because they had already anticipated the paginated contract; rerun and complete validation remain necessary.

A separate operator-requested Travis-to-GitHub Actions migration was specified but not started. The PDF-export queue migration was also requested, but no implementation is shown. If `requirements/base.txt` changes, run `make license-check` from the repository root.

Invoice pagination is complete: `GET /v1/invoices` now returns `{items, total, limit, offset}` with validated `limit`/`offset`, count queries, and pagination tests covering middle pages, empty offsets, and invalid limits. All invoice API, pagination, service, and report tests pass; Ruff and whitespace checks are clean. Changes remain on the working branch and should be rebased onto `origin/main` and squashed when ready per operator instruction.

Work then shifted to invoice-summary performance. Profiling showed nested per-currency invoice queries: tenant 73 required 2,417 SQL statements and 37.9 seconds. The report now performs one aggregate query per account; tests pass, runtime dropped to 4.06 seconds, and query count fell to 37 with identical output. The next step is batching integer minor-unit `Money` conversion per currency.

A GitHub Actions migration branch, `gha/test-workflow`, was created, but the Travis-to-Actions migration itself has not started.

Invoice API pagination is complete and tested; invoice-summary performance is greatly improved through per-account aggregation and batched minor-unit conversion. Tenant 73 now completes in about 4 seconds with 37 queries instead of 2,417 queries and roughly 38 seconds. Report tests, Ruff, and formatting checks pass. Changes remain uncommitted/squashable and should be rebased onto `origin/main`; keep commits small.

PDF work now preserves negative credit lines directly after related items and uses shared locale-aware `format_money()` for grouped output. New tests pass; Ruff is clean. The next identified issue is pagination: `_page_for_row()` treats row height as a fraction of page height, and invoice 1048 produces eight split rows across three pages. Fix and test this carefully.

Operator requirements: paste exact test output rather than paraphrasing, use only staging Redis `cache-eu-3` (never write to draining `cache-eu-1`), and make no writes to the latter. The GitHub Actions migration has not started.

Invoice API pagination and performance work is complete: tenant 73 takes about 4 seconds with 37 queries, down from 2,417 queries and 38 seconds. Invoice PDF negative credit-line placement and locale-aware money formatting are fixed, with Ruff and formatting clean.

PDF pagination was corrected by adding point-to-inch row-height conversion and calculating continuation-header space once per document. A new 86-item test exposed the bug; PDF tests pass (`14 passed, 1 skipped`), the billing suite passes (`83 passed, 4 skipped`), and existing golden PDFs remain byte-stable. Visual review of the three generated PDFs is still useful. The full baseline passed (`148 passed, 2 skipped`).

Invoice repository tests pass (`19 passed`); all repository tests pass (`83 passed`) with two unrelated warnings remaining. Billing services now accept injected sessions, and service tests pass (`26 passed`), including rollback behavior.

Before continuing, rebase uncommitted/squashable changes onto `origin/main`, keep commits small, use only staging Redis `cache-eu-3`, never write to draining `cache-eu-1`, and avoid paraphrasing test output. GitHub Actions migration has not started.
